features.name: Band: Flat 3.2 × 2.4, its shoulders swelling to the head
Basket head: four claws paired at the ends, two rails, set into the collar
Seat bur, through to the finger, cut at the bench
Drop window, through both side faces along the finger
Array the window down the shoulder
Mirror the first window to the other shoulder
Mirror the array to the other shoulder

field_notes: Lost wax: no undercut anywhere — this pattern would also pull from two-part sand.
Measured with the ring as built: 6 CAD parts (1 joined, 5 cut), 310.6 mm² of part surface; under lost wax they are reported, never gating.

Lost wax: Basket "Basket head: four claws paired at the ends, two rails, set into the collar" (#3) would undercut a two-part pull over 59.1 mm² (worst -90°) — fine for investment, but this pattern cannot move to sand as-is.

Lost wax: Seat bur "Seat bur, through to the finger, cut at the bench" (#4) would undercut a two-part pull over 25.0 mm² (worst -89°) — fine for investment, but this pattern cannot move to sand as-is.

head_thickness_informational.note: The made basket head alone: each claw notched by the stone's envelope for the girdle, set at the bench.

made_part_self_crossings: Basket head: four claws paired at the ends, two rails, set into the collar
Seat bur, through to the finger, cut at the bench
Drop window, through both side faces along the finger
Array the window down the shoulder

Mirror the array to the other shoulder

thickness.mesh: the poured shank: the casting pattern with the bench's basket head and seat bur suppressed
thickness.note: Up to 384 surface-normal samples on the display mesh; small unsampled features and oblique walls require section inspection

thickness_finished_informational.note: The finished ring after the bench's seat bur, which notches the claws for the girdle and opens the pilot; not the pour.
